records.subject: Marital Status, Marriages and Divorces
records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Resident Females Aged 20 - 24 Years Who Were Married Before Age 15 Or 18
records.title: Proportion Of Resident Females Aged 20 - 24 Years Who Were Married Before Age 15 Or 18, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to Singapore residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents). Data from 2003 onwards exclude residents who are overseas for a continuous period of 12 months or longer as at the reference period. Data are used for SDG 5.3.1 'Proportion of women aged 20 24 years who were married or in a union before age 15 and before age 18'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 5.3.1.
